t: You're outside George, a private members' club at 87 to 88 Mount Street in Mayfair. It was established in 2001 by Mark Birley, the British entrepreneur known for his work in hospitality. In 2007 he sold it to Richard Caring, along with his four other Mayfair clubs: Annabel's, Mark's Club, Harry's Bar, and the Bath and Racquets Club. George is also dog-friendly, which is not something every members' club can say.
